proofs.proves: A prompt is one direct instruction to make an output.
proofs.recognizableObject: A short MAKE ME AN AD prompt card.
proofs.cropInstruction: Keep only the single prompt card large enough to read instantly.

proofs.proves: A Format contains multiple reusable creative parts.
proofs.recognizableObject: A compact Format card with rules, examples, assets, and quality checks.
proofs.cropInstruction: Show the complete Format card with every component visibly grouped.

proofs.proves: A node workflow connects generation tools.
proofs.recognizableObject: Three connected IMAGE, VIDEO, and VOICE nodes.
proofs.cropInstruction: Keep the three connected nodes centered with no surrounding interface.

proofs.proves: An agent skill includes instructions and creative checks.
proofs.recognizableObject: A single agent-skill card with visible checklist items.
proofs.cropInstruction: Keep the skill card centered and its short checklist readable.

proofs.proves: One AI ad is a single finished output.
proofs.cropInstruction: Show one full ad clearly, without additional examples around it.

proofs.proves: Wiggly packages multiple reusable creative outputs and their system.
proofs.recognizableObject: A Wiggly card showing several coordinated creative outputs.
proofs.cropInstruction: Keep the grouped Wiggly outputs large and centered.
